about_the_game:
“Attention, passengers. This train will now be terminating at Sylvan Station. We apologize for any inconvenience, and we thank you for traveling with us tonight.”

When returning home from the grocer's one quiet evening, Tera is taken away to Sylvan Station, a place you won’t find on any route or map. Amidst the wither and rot of the station, she meets another passenger who warns her of horrors impending and urges her to run. The night of terror is about to begin...

Survival Horror Gameplay in Visual Novel Form

As you explore Sylvan Station, you will add items to your inventory, hide from danger, and face monsters.

Engrossing Narrative

Lose yourself to two plus hours of razor-sharp horror storytelling, complete with unforgettable characters and a setting that will haunt your dreams.

Immersive Environments

Photorealistic backgrounds will draw you into the harrowing world of Sylvan Station.

Vivid Character Art

Hand-drawn sprites express a gallery of emotions, ranging from fear to fury, loneliness to lust, and sadness to joy.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of violence, sexual references, and topics of a mature or sensitive nature. It is not recommended for persons under the age of 18.
